This small plot of 0.25 ha is my main maize for the family to eat, so I must take care of it. I went to school for some years, so I know the value of fertilizer and good seed, but cash is always tight. If I get the FISP coupon this year like many of my neighbors in Ntchisi, I will buy one bag of NPK 23-21-0+4S for basal and one bag of urea for topdressing — that is enough for this small plot and maybe a little for my other plots. I always put the manure from my chickens and goats first because it costs me nothing, and I weed with my wife and children since hiring labor for such a small plot is wasteful.
